title: Kyle meets time-inconsistency: a dynamic mean--variance informed trading problem
summary: We study a Kyle--Back model in which the informed trader has dynamic mean--variance preferences, leading to a time-inconsistent trading problem that is formulated as an intrapersonal game. The model combines two equilibrium requirements: a trading--pricing equilibrium between the informed trader and the market maker, and a time-consistent equilibrium among the trader's successive selves. Following the framework of Cho (2003), we consider both risk-neutral and risk-averse informed traders.
